instructions: Retain package-specific license and copyright notices; Numina BSD terms do not replace upstream terms.
Review exact native binaries and dependencies of the target host when packaging, not only declared requirements.
Review the GPL Solidity compiler separately from the solc-js MIT wrapper before redistributing compiler binaries; compilation does not by itself grant a license to or require rewriting Numina source.

For LGPL psycopg/psycopg-binary and MPL certifi, comply with applicable source, modification, linking and redistribution obligations for the distributed artifact. Hosted access alone is not a claim that these dependencies are relicensed.
Do not distribute development packages with incomplete publisher license text until the upstream notice is obtained or the dependency is removed from that distributable.
Provider APIs, cloud services, model weights and remotely hosted fonts are subject to separate contracts; a package license is not an account entitlement.
